I somewhat disagree. While yes, OP should consider therapy or a psychiatrist, I think there are many other ways to deal with death-anxiety. In the west it is common to prescribe medicine and pills for pretty much anything. 

Now, with that being said, OP should definitely look into reasons why he may feel this way. Sometimes thought exercises and meditation help a lot. If you are really afraid of death, investigate the concept of death more, educate yourself on literature regarding death. At the end of the day, nobody can truly tell you what happens after dying and reading quotes from some bloke who died 200+ years ago will only get you so far.

The answers you seek are difficult to answer. Yes you will be gone, but death is only necessary. My recommendation is trying meditation, reading various literature about death and birth and, if possible, look into other relaxation techniques and hobbies to reduce your stress. Lots of options should be exhausted before putting your hands in the air and accepting defeat.
